headline: Added options to sort items by vendor sell price and fixed bag re-sorting when items are looted while bags are open.

entries.title: Sort items by vendor sell price
entries.details: Added Sell Price (Stack) and Sell Price (Each) options to the Item Order setting, sorting items within sections from highest to lowest vendor value. Items that cannot be sold to a merchant are placed at the end.

entries.title: Items looted while bags are open now re-sort on close
entries.details: When slot preservation is enabled, items collected or stacks that grew while bags were open now correctly re-sort into their proper positions after closing and reopening your bags.
